primaryGoal: Identify which observed signals have stopped arriving without mistaking sleeping vehicles, unknown timestamps or retained responses for vehicle health verdicts.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Catalog duplicates formatStaleness and row/timestamp derivation already provided by signalGapUtils. Catalog computes age at render time whereas summary derives at dataUpdatedAt; thresholds and clocks can disagree.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing domain derivation/formatter with explicit rawValue preservation and a deliberate common reference clock; retain current catalog active-through-aging filter semantics pending a separately reviewed behavior correction.

responsive.sourceBehavior: Hero stacks below xl, chart spans two of three columns at xl; min-w-0 guards; catalog toolbar stacks below sm and wraps pills/sort buttons; chart category labels are always shown.

findings.detail: Only signal name is visibleOnMobile. DataTable derives a mobile allow-list from flagged columns and hides all others below md. This caller supplies no mobilePresentation or detail expansion, so status, last value, timestamp and age lose their direct table presentation on phones.
findings.fix: Use the existing typed mobile presentation/detail contract to retain all five cells, or keep all columns in a contained horizontal-scroll strategy; preserve filters, sorting, paging and exports.

sourceStrengths: Refresh action localized and named; decorative refresh icon hidden
Health section has localized accessible name
Distribution legend includes counts, not color alone

findings.detail: ProgressRing has a domain ariaLabel prop, but freshness caller omits it. Shared fallback names the image generically as Progress: percent; center freshness text is aria-hidden.
findings.fix: Pass a localized signal-freshness ariaLabel including the percentage and retain the textual receiving/total context.

findings.detail: SourceContent is always ready except fatal error; initial skeleton and empty body are implemented beneath ready instead of using existing loading/empty states. The wrapper's localized loading status is therefore bypassed.
findings.fix: Map trust and no-vehicle/initial/empty cases explicitly through SourceContent, using loadingContent to preserve the eight-row skeleton and specialist emptyContent/recovery where needed.

sourceCoverage.noVehicle: Page AlertBanner, unknown KPI values, panel manage-vehicles actions; catalog still displays generic no-data text.
sourceCoverage.loading: KPI loading flag and panel 260px skeletons; catalog eight-row skeleton.
sourceCoverage.empty: Hero panels use EmptyState; catalog distinguishes empty map from no filter matches; summary currently shows numerical zero buckets and zero freshness after successful empty response.
sourceCoverage.fatalError: Persistent panel shells with QueryError/SourceContent retry; no global content gate.
sourceCoverage.refreshError: useDataState fatal-vs-refresh distinction and StaleRefreshWarning preserve retained data in panels/catalog; summary retained label.
sourceCoverage.offline: Shared DataState exposes paused state and StaleRefreshWarning names retained offline values; initial paused query is not handled as a separate prerequisite in KPI availability.
sourceCoverage.partial: One shared live-map request; source completeness metadata is not inspected or inferred.

findings.detail: KPI unavailability is fatalError or isLoading without data. A pending but paused initial query can have isLoading=false and no retained data, leaving available=true and emitting six derived zero values. A successful empty map also emits 0% freshness despite the hero panels correctly treating it as no signal data.
findings.fix: Base metric availability on sourceState.hasData plus explicit empty-denominator handling, not only isLoading; preserve legitimate zero counts while keeping an unmeasured percentage null. Distinguish initial offline/pending from empty success.

visualIssues.detail: Distribution and gauge use local hardcoded green/amber/red/slate hex colors independent of canonical chart/semantic palette; catalog additionally uses fixed green-400/red-400 age text and purple-400 sort treatment. No neon classes found, but theme/semantic consistency remains source-level debt, not a measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic/chart tokens without resetting saved palette preferences; preserve category meaning and text labels. Do not introduce a new palette registry.

architectureIssues.detail: ArrowUpDown is rendered but not imported or declared in the inspected 368-line dependency. lucide-react import at line 16 includes only Filter, Plus, RefreshCw and X. This is a source-confirmed unresolved identifier in the always-mounted catalog.
architectureIssues.fix: Import ArrowUpDown from the existing icon library or use the canonical registry without altering sort actions.
architectureIssues.evidenceLimit: No TypeScript/build/browser run; runtime crash is not claimed as exercised.

architectureIssues.detail: Row category/catalog stale filter uses age >300 while bucket, badge and top-stale membership use >=300. At exactly 300 seconds, a stale-badged row counted by stale KPI can be included under active-only and excluded under stale-only. Catalog and summary use different reference clocks as well.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve boundaries through existing domain constants/derivation in a narrowly tested logic correction; preserve the intentionally broader catalog active category and all existing filters rather than silently redefining it during styling.

architectureIssues.detail: Both local age formatters build English s/m/h ago strings directly. Localized labels wrap the display but do not localize this relative-age phrase.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing locale-aware relative timestamp/duration formatting after proving floor/clamp precision parity; do not add another formatter or change raw seconds.
